sources.name: RIVM/CVGG — EU END 2021 noise contours (major airports)
sources.dataType: Schiphol Lden noise contours, 5 dB bands 55-75 (actual traffic 2021, EU END)
sources.notes: Verified 2026-09-30: data.overheid.nl dataset bc7703a1-9323-4e4f-9ce7-246ace877b59 (“Geluidbelastingkaart hoofd luchthavens, Lden en Lnight, 2021 (INSPIRE)”), licence CC-0 1.0. WFS feature type gpkg:NoiseContours_majorAirportsIncludingAgglomeration_Lden (haleconnect). Categories Lden5559/Lden6064/Lden6569/Lden7074/LdenGreaterThan75 are mapped to band lower bounds 55/60/65/70/75, kind “actual”. Schiphol only in this build. The Atlas Leefomgeving “Geluid van vliegverkeer” WMS rasters are NOT used (raster, no polygons). Agglomeration-cut regional contours NOT used (cut at agglomeration boundaries, would mislead).

sources.name: CLO/NLR — regional noise contours 2018 & 2024
sources.dataType: Lden contours for Rotterdam, Eindhoven, Maastricht, Groningen Eelde
sources.notes: CC-BY applies to CLO content unless stated otherwise (clo.nl copyright page: figures may be reused freely with attribution, under the creative commons licence; photos are excluded). CLO indicator 0588 (v04, 2026-08-31) publishes 48/56/70 dB(A) Lden contours 2018 & 2024 for Eindhoven/Rotterdam/Maastricht/Groningen as MAP IMAGES ONLY; the data.pbl.nl infographic embeds (0588_001k/002k/004k/005k_clo_04_nl) offer bitmap and PDF downloads only.
